topic: Does rotation data augmentation make a small CNN more robust to rotated images on CIFAR-10?

trace.plan: Evaluate the robustness of a small CNN (e.g., VGG-11) to rotated images on CIFAR-10 by comparing its performance with and without rotation data augmentation. Use the CIFAR-10-Warehouse testbed to generate rotated images for testing. Train the model on the original CIFAR-10 dataset and then test it on both the original and rotated images. Measure accuracy as the metric. Compare the accuracy drop when the model is tested on rotated images with and without rotation data augmentation during training. Use a test set of at least 200 examples for each condition.
